description: Write a pandas ETL script for health_portal that converts a member CSV export to Parquet with an explicit schema. The script should: (1) read every column as string first (dtype=str, keep_default_na=False), (2) keep zip_code and member_no as strings to preserve leading zeros, (3) cast account_ref to int64 without passing through float, (4) map is_active 'Y'/'N' to boolean, (5) convert empty strings to null for nullable columns only, (6) parse signup_date (YYYY-MM-DD) to date and balance to decimal(12,2), (7) write Parquet with an explicit pyarrow schema.
edge_cases: Type inference turns zip_code '02134' into the integer 2134 and member_no '000451' into 451
The last name 'NA' is a real surname; pandas' default NA values convert it to NaN
9007199254740993 is not representable as float64 (it becomes ...992); the cast must be string to int64 directly
is_active 'N' must map to False; bool('N') is True in Python
common_failure_modes: FM5: Inferred dtypes strip leading zeros and corrupt large integers through float conversion
FM7: Default NA parsing nulls out legitimate values such as 'NA'
FM4: Truthiness-based boolean cast maps every non-empty string to True
